text:
Predicates:
Capital(x, y) ::: x is the capital of y.
Located(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Host(x, y) ::: x hosted y.
University(x) ::: x is a university.
Rank(x, y) ::: x ranks among y.
Olympics(x) ::: x is the Olympics.
Paralympics(x) ::: x is the Paralympics.
Summer(x) ::: x is Summer.
Winter(x) ::: x is Winter.
Premises:
Capital(beijing, peopleRepublicOfChina) ::: Beijing is the capital of the People's Republic of China.
Capital(beijing, world'sMostPopulousNation) ::: Beijing is the capital city of the world's most populous nation.
Located(beijing, northernChina) ::: Beijing is located in Northern China.
Host(beijing, 2008SummerOlympics) ∧ Host(beijing, 2008SummerParalympics) ::: Beijing hosted the 2008 Summer Olympics and 2008 Summer Paralympics Games.
Host(beijing, SummerOlympics) ∧ Host(beijing, WinterOlympics) ∧ Host(beijing, SummerParalympics) ∧ Host(beijing, WinterParalympics) ::: Beijing has hosted the Summer and Winter Olympics and the Summer and Winter Paralympics.
∃x (University(x) ∧ Rank(x, bestUniversitiesInTheWorld)) ::: Many of Beijing's 91 universities consistently rank among the best universities in the world.
Conclusion:
Host(beijing, 2008SummerOlympics) ∧ Host(beijing, WinterOlympics) ::: Beijing hosted both the 2008 Summer Olympics and the Winter Olympics.
